hydro generation, TWhno 2024 reading

2024 hydro generation of 41 European countries, on the map: each country takes the place of its own territory.

Russia alone generated 211 TWh of hydropower in 2024 — 23.8 % of everything Europe's hydro plants produced.

Give every country the same room: one equal tile, arranged roughly as the map. Add Norway and Turkey and the top three already reach 47.9 %.

Now resize each tile to the hydro TWh its country actually produced. France and Sweden complete the top five — 63.3 % from just five of 40 reporting countries.

One country already a quarter, three near half, five nearly two-thirds: three counts of the same concentration.

Ukraine has no 2024 reading: its tile stays empty. The other thirty-plus countries in this panel share what is left.
